findings.title: Sub-BAA or Data Use Agreement required for Pune entity before data access
findings.deviation: Section 6.3 states that a Data Use Agreement for the Limited Data Set will be provided 'if required', whereas AtliQ's playbook requires a signed sub-BAA or DUA for all entities handling regulated data (including AtliQ's Pune entity) before data access begins.
findings.impact: AtliQ's Pune entity could access regulated health data without an executed sub-BAA or Data Use Agreement in place, creating HIPAA compliance risk.
findings.quote: Ashwood's Operations team confirms this approach is acceptable. A data use agreement for the Limited Data Set will be provided by Ashwood if required.
findings.counterPosition: Execute the required sub-BAA or Data Use Agreement between AtliQ Inc, Ashwood, and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd prior to granting offshore team members access to the data.

fine.note: 10 business days review period for deliverables is standard and acceptable.
